t: For an additional amount for compensation of Members of the House of Representatives, Delegates from Territories, and the Resident Commissioner from Puerto Rico, fiscal year 1947, $548,750.

fable.w: This is a pure appropriation of additional funds to pay Members of the House, Delegates, and the Resident Commissioner for fiscal year 1947. The only tempting reading is that it names particular people, but they are all inside the federal government and are merely being paid. No outside party is consulted, heard, or given any right to object to or sue over a federal decision.

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple appropriation of funds for the salaries of federal legislators. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or decision-making process with parties outside the federal government. Members of Congress are inside the federal government, and paying them is an internal administrative matter.
